title: Hearty Indulgent Jamaican Cheese Grill
description: A fresh and indulgent Jamaican dish featuring melted cheese, pickles, and grilled goodness, suitable for shojin-friendly diets. This recipe combines the flavors of Jamaica with the comfort of a cheese grill.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, around 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Butter one side of each bread slice with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Place two bread slices, buttered side down, on the grill.
Top each bread slice with a slice of Jamaican jerk cheese, a few slices of dill pickle, some red onion, and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
Place the remaining bread slices, buttered side up, on top of the filling.
Grill for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Carefully flip the sandwiches over and grill for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
Remove the sandwiches from the grill and sprinkle with Jamaican jerk seasoning.
Let the sandwiches cool for a minute or two before serving.
